candidates.title: Identify purge candidates with customizable criteria
candidates.statement: The system shall provide a way to identify item records to purge based on customizable criteria (for example: item status 'missing' for more than X months; item status 'discard/weed').
candidates.source_quote: I need to identify item records to purge based on customizable criteria.

candidates.title: Support status/time/activity criteria and combination
candidates.statement: The system shall support status-based criteria (e.g., missing, discard/weed, damaged), time-based criteria (e.g., in a status for X months/years), and activity-based criteria (e.g., last circulated X days/months/years), and allow combining those criteria (e.g., AND combinations).
candidates.source_quote: I want the customizable criteria for purging to include: - Status-based criteria ... - Time-based criteria ... - Activity-based criteria ... Can we combine these?

candidates.title: Batch status conversion report and action
candidates.statement: The system shall provide a report and batch operation that allows converting the status of multiple items at once (for example, change 100 items from 'missing' to 'discard/weed').
candidates.source_quote: I need a report to help convert items from one status to another in batch. Like changing 100 items from "missing" to "discard/weed" at once.
candidates.priority_signals: "This is huge... The batch status conversion alone would save us hours"

candidates.title: Last copy report with scope-aware flagging
candidates.statement: The system shall provide a "last copy report" that determines for each item whether it is the only copy within a specified scope and flags it, supporting both per-library and per-system (consortium) scopes.
candidates.source_quote: CRITICAL: We need a "last copy report" that identifies our library system's last copies.
candidates.priority_signals: CRITICAL; multiple participants requested per-library and per-system views

candidates.title: Last copy report to assist WorldCat updates
candidates.statement: The system shall provide data in the last copy report in a format that assists catalogers in identifying items that may require updates to external catalogs (for example, WorldCat) before deletion.
candidates.source_quote: This helps catalogers update WorldCat entries so we don't accidentally delete the only copy in the consortium.

candidates.title: Delete volumes with copies and orphaned records
candidates.statement: The system shall provide a utility to delete volume entries together with their associated copy entries, and to delete bibliographic/other records that have no items attached (orphaned records).
candidates.source_quote: We also need a quick way to delete volume entries along with copy entries, and delete records with no items attached.

candidates.title: Read-only preview of purge candidates
candidates.statement: The system shall display reports of purge candidates in a read-only preview mode so users can review candidates without performing deletions directly from the report.

candidates.title: Confirmation step before deletions
candidates.statement: The system shall require a separate explicit confirmation step before performing any deletion operations identified by purge reports.
candidates.source_quote: A separate confirmation step for actual deletions

candidates.title: Audit trail for purge actions
candidates.statement: The system shall maintain an audit trail for all purge-related actions that records who performed the action, what was deleted/changed, and when it occurred.
candidates.priority_signals: "We need to track who purged what and when."

candidates.title: Scheduling of purging utility
candidates.statement: The system shall allow the purging utility (reports or cleanup operations) to be scheduled to run automatically at specified times (for example, annually at the end of the year).
candidates.source_quote: can the purging utility be scheduled? Like, run automatically at the end of each year?

candidates.title: Safeguards to prevent mass accidental deletion
candidates.statement: The system shall include safeguards to prevent accidental mass deletion of collections (for example: limits/warnings on large batches, role-based restrictions, read-only previews, mandatory confirmations, and audit logging).
candidates.source_quote: we need to be careful here. "Customizable criteria" is great, but we need to make sure the system is safe - we don't want someone accidentally deleting their entire collection.
